expected: The Guest should be able to open TCP to the Host's allowlisted relay port while all other external traffic remains blocked.
impact: The Agent reached the correct provider/relay code path but could not send a model request; no Agent work report was produced. This is transport infrastructure failure, not a model or sample conclusion.
optimization_location: Host firewall rule for the project-local model relay; do not broaden Guest routing.
minimal_change: Allow TCP 18181 only from 172.31.250.2 to local 172.31.250.1, scoped to the relay node process and recorded for cleanup.
rollback: Remove the exact named firewall rule and stop the relay process after the next run.
verification: Guest healthz request returns 200, relay log records the request, then a new Agent run reaches the model provider or produces a distinguishable upstream response.
unresolved_risk: The free upstream may still reject the model after transport is fixed; that must be classified separately.
